messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: GRC & SecEng headcount authorization + offer templates

Hi team,

Following up from our staffing planning sync — attaching the formal request for headcount and comp bands for the GRC and Security Engineering hires we discussed. Summary: 

- Role A: Senior Security Engineer (1 FTE) — proposed band: $220k - $260k TC (base + equity target).
- Role B: GRC Manager (1 FTE) — proposed band: $150k - $185k TC.
- Role C: Senior Analyst, Compliance Automation (contract 9 months) — proposed rate: $85/hr (contractor).

Attachments: GRC_headcount_request_Q4.pdf, comp-band-proposal-2026.xlsx, offer_template_sr_seceng.docx (draft).

What I need from approvers:
1) Approve / request changes to banding for Role A and Role B.
2) Approve hiring type for Role C (contract vs FTE).
3) Permission to extend a verbal offer to Alex Romero (candidate flagged by Greenline Talent) for Role A subject to final sign-off.

Timing: would like to get final approvals and templates by EOD 2026-12-22 so recruiting can lock start dates for early February.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Sr. Director, Security & GRC
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GRC & SecEng headcount authorization + offer templates

Priyom —

Thanks for the packet and clear ask. A couple of items before I can fully sign off on the Sr. SecEng band: 

- Market comp: can you add a one-paragraph benchmark (sources + 90th percentile justification) for the $260k top of band? We want to ensure our offer remains defensible for candidates with deep infra/LLM inference experience.
- Equity: propose we cap initial equity at the level listed in the comp spreadsheet; please confirm refresh schedule (annual vs refresh window).

Also, curious why Role C is proposed as a contractor vs FTE — that impacts benefits and onboarding for compliance evidence collection. If it's a strictly project-limited piece of automation, contractor is fine; if longer-lived, prefer FTE.

Marking tentative approval for Role B (GRC Manager) pending final comp confirmation.

Date: 2026-12-21T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GRC & SecEng headcount authorization + offer templates

All —

I reviewed the packet. Approve as proposed with one operational change request: convert Role C to a fixed-term contractor (9 months) but route onboarding through our vendor-management compliance flow (we need the contractor SOW before start). This keeps flexibility and avoids immediate headcount pressure.

Laura: I can pull market comps for the Sr. SecEng role and push a short memo by EOD today with benchmark references (Payscale, Level.fyi sampling, two comparable FAANG infra listings).

Priyom: please ensure the offer_template_sr_seceng.docx includes the following clauses: 
- Data access limited to non-production sandboxes until 90-day security review.
- Mandatory background + device security attestation.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Candidate update: Alex Romero (Sr. Security Engineer) — availability and expectations

Hi Priyom —

Quick update on Alex Romero: he completed his final technical interview yesterday and is enthusiastic about Redwood. His current compensation is $235k TC; target for a move is between $240k - $260k TC depending on equity and role scope. He is available to start mid-February provided we can align on notice and relocation support (he is West Coast-based).

Attached: candidate CV (sent separately to recruiting). Alex confirmed he's comfortable with the 90-day sandbox restriction you referenced.

If you authorize a verbal offer at the top of the hiring band, we can ask him to hold through early January for an official DocuSign.

Best,

Subject: Final authorization: extend verbal offer + docs to issue

Thanks everyone — consolidating approvals: 

- Role A (Sr. SecEng): Approved at band $220k - $260k TC; Laura will provide the 90th percentile memo (expect by COB tomorrow). We will proceed with a verbal offer at $255k TC + standard equity package; final DocuSign to follow when HR confirms equity grant.
- Role B (GRC Manager): Approved at proposed band; Priyom to work with Mina on final JD and posting.
- Role C: Approved as a 9-month contractor per Rishi's note. Mina, please route SOW through vendor management.

Attachments: offer_template_sr_seceng.docx (updated locally with the clauses Rishi requested).

Next steps: 
1) Payroll OPS — please standby for a comp confirmation email and DocuSign link (I'll send the candidate details and started compensation packet).
2) Recruiting (Greenline) — you have authorization to deliver a verbal offer up to $255k TC and request that Alex hold acceptance until we send a formal DocuSign in early Jan.
3) HR — use comp-band-proposal-2026.xlsx for the offer paperwork and include the standard new-hire security onboarding checklist.

DocuSign template link: https://docusign.com/abc123-offer-templates
HR ticket created: HR-Ticket-#78934

I'll follow up with the finalized offer package tomorrow.
